translations.text: I am repentant (an excellent occasion), O Lord, for my transgression: forgive me every sin that has come upon me, O Christ, for the sake of your mercy.
By your gentle coming into a body, by your birth, O my holy King, by your excellent baptism here, forgive me every transgression.
By your crucifixion in full, by your resurrection from the dead, grant me forgiveness of my [?], for you are a truly merciful Lord.
By your ascension (a noble moment) to the Father in holy heaven, as you told us before departing, forgive me my transgression.
By your coming (divine the summons) to judge the host of Adam's seed, by the nine orders of heaven (without concealment), may my sins be forgiven me.
By the company of the true prophets, by the praiseworthy throng of the martyrs, forgive me every sin that has seized me, by the band of the patriarchs.
By the company of the apostles without fault, by the host of the pure disciples, by every saint with royal grace, forgive me my misdeeds.
By every holy virgin throughout the mighty world, by the company of women of the foremost laity, forgive me every sin under heaven, by the wondrous Virgin Mary.
By the people of the earth (a dear multitude), by the people of bright holy heaven, grant the best forgiveness for my sins, since I am repentant.
